systemName: 午前中クラブ グリッドシステム
description: レスポンシブデザインに対応したフルードグリッドシステム。画面幅に応じてカラム幅が伸縮し、1696pxでレイアウトが固定される。

columnWidth.calculationNote: Calculated based on screen width, columns, gutter, and margin.

sideMargin.behavior: Minimum value fixed per breakpoint up to freeze point.
sideMargin.note: Additional whitespace added outside the minimum margin above freeze point.

corePrinciples.contentArea: Region within screen width excluding side margins.
corePrinciples.centering: Layout is centered horizontally at all breakpoints.

freezePoint.description: Layout width becomes fixed at this screen width and above.

majorBreakpoints.name: Mobile
notes: 通常のマージン目標は24px (`spacing-24`)。
画面が狭い場合、カラム幅80px維持のため、まずマージンを最小16pxまで縮小。
目安384px未満では、カラム幅80px未満を許容。(詳細は運用ガイドライン参照)

majorBreakpoints.name: Desktop X-Wide
notes: 1696pxを超えるとレイアウトは固定され中央揃え。超過分はマージン外の余白として吸収。

columnSpanning.guideline: Primarily use defined columns (12, 8, 4). Spanning columns is permitted. Avoid further subdividing single columns if possible.
columnSpanning.calculationBasis: Consider total width of spanned columns and included gutters.

spacingTokens.usage: Must be used for gutter widths and minimum side margins.
spacingTokens.management: Recommended to manage as styles/variables in design tools.

contentAreaGuideline.behaviorBelowFreeze: Fluid, content area width changes with screen width.
contentAreaGuideline.behaviorAtOrAboveFreeze: Layout width fixed at 1696px, centered. Additional space absorbed outside defined margins.

operationalGuidelines.considerAllBreakpoints: Verify design and functionality across all breakpoints, boundaries, and around the freeze point.

adjustmentSteps: Mobile: If column width < 80px (approx. < 400px screen), reduce side margin from 24px target down to 16px minimum.
Mobile: If still insufficient (approx. < 384px screen), permit column width < 80px.
minColumnWidthMaintenance.implementation: Design content to reflow naturally. Do not force 80px min-width with CSS.
minColumnWidthMaintenance.designConsideration: Ensure minimal readability even below 80px column width.

operationalGuidelines.componentDesign: Base reusable components on this grid system (columns, gutters, 8px grid, freeze behavior). Ensure proper scaling/reflowing.
operationalGuidelines.extremeScreenwidths: Consider requirements for very narrow (< 320px) or very wide screens if necessary.
